note: Public E.V (the esp32s3 file dfa9af416dfb) re-quantized for the ESP32-S31 by ESP-PPQ (target esp32s31, w8a16, int16_lut_step=-1) from the same ONNX graph and calibration windows; every weight dequantises to the esp32s3 value and every bias to within one esp32s3 step. The S31 target stores one weight exponent per output channel. int16_lut_step=-1: no int16 LUT, so ESP-DL runs its native int16 Relu and the chip matches the ESP-PPQ simulation bit for bit (the default step-256 LUT is evaluated nearest-neighbour on the chip).
